idea: AgentSIM connects AI agent identities to the people who authorize them. An owner creates a signed permission with an approved supplier, budget and expiry. The agent uses its own key to act independently; the owner can revoke future access. Our working implementation demonstrates permitted payments, blocked overspending and revoked authority. The integration architecture combines SIM-class owner signing with NEAR policy enforcement. We target agent platforms, then supported SIM/eSIM provisioning and mobile-operator distribution. The reference demo uses real software signatures and simulated settlement; hardware and live deployment claims need separate evidence. This October code baseline requires prior-work eligibility clarification for the November event.
